annotations.title: Pricing calculator: margin vs markup, fees, discounts, target price

description: Pricing calculator: margin vs markup, fees, discounts, target price — Unit pricing math. cost= (required) plus one of price=, margin= (% of price) or markup= (% of cost). Optional fee_pct= and fee_fixed= payment fees (e.g. 2.9 and 0.30) for net margin, target_margin= to get the required price (fees grossed up), discount= % to see the extra volume needed to keep the same profit, price_change= % for the volume you can lose, tax_rate=, volume= for totals. Returns price, gross profit, margin %, markup %, multiplier, margin band LOSS/VERY_THIN/THIN/HEALTHY/STRONG and prices for 25/40/50/60% margins. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_pricing
